e2e.name: Context To Strategy
e2e.goals: Define context, policy, strategy, objectives, compliance, governance
e2e.trigger: Strategic planning cycle, management review output, or significant context change
e2e.terminal: Approved policy, strategy, objectives, risk register, compliance framework in place
e2e.description: Establishes the strategic foundation of the IMS — context, policy, objectives, processes, risks, requirements, and policies.
e2e.relations: Feeds E2E-02, E2E-03, E2E-04; Informs E2E-08, E2E-10, E2E-12
e2e.modules: Context, Policy, Objectives, Process, Risk, Compliance, SME
e2e.mpCodes: UMS016, UMS022, UMS031, UMS002, UMS023, UMS030, UMS044, GRC001, GRC002, GRC003, GRC005, DMS034, DMS044, DMS082, DMS083
e2e.narrative: This process establishes the strategic foundation of the entire IMS. It begins by understanding the organization's internal and external context — regulatory, market, technological, and cultural. From this understanding, it defines the quality policy, strategic direction, and measurable objectives. It then maps the process architecture, manages enterprise risks and opportunities, harmonizes overlapping requirements across standards, and governs policies and procedures. For SMEs, it provides simplified onboarding and process modeling.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures the IMS is aligned with business strategy from day one and provides the foundation for every subsequent E2E process.

e2e.name: Leadership To Commitment
e2e.goals: Establish leadership, competence, communication, audit capability
e2e.terminal: Competent personnel, communication plan, qualified auditors in place
e2e.relations: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-05, E2E-08
e2e.modules: Competence, Communication, Audit, Collaboration, Environmental Communication, SME Expert, SME Training
e2e.mpCodes: UMS006, UMS032, UMS035, DMS043, DMS077, DMS081, DMS085, DMS091
e2e.narrative: This process ensures that the human and communication foundation of the IMS is in place. It builds competence across the workforce, establishes internal and external communication channels, qualifies and certifies internal auditors, manages collaborative business relationships with partners, and handles environmental communication. For SMEs, it provides fractional expert access and simplified training management.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures that people are competent, informed, and aligned — the single most important enabler of IMS success.

e2e.name: Risk To Resilience
e2e.goals: Manage controls, third-party risk, continuity, functional safety, process safety, crisis

flow.seqTaskIds: GRC009, DMS048–DMS055, DMS057, DMS059, DMS060, DMS070

e2e.trigger: Risk assessment cycle, incident, regulatory change, or functional safety requirement
e2e.terminal: Controls, third-party risk managed, continuity tested, functional/process safety assured, crisis ready
e2e.relations: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-11, E2E-12
e2e.modules: Controls, Third-Party, Investigation, Continuity, Functional Safety, Process Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Asset Integrity, Maritime, Road Safety, SME Risk
e2e.mpCodes: GRC004, GRC006, GRC007, GRC009, DMS037, DMS047, DMS048–DMS055, DMS057, DMS059, DMS060, DMS070, DMS088, DMS101
e2e.narrative: This process makes the organization resilient against operational, safety, and regulatory risks. It covers internal controls (including SOX), third-party and supplier risk, whistleblowing and incident investigation, business continuity and crisis preparedness, continuous controls monitoring, crisis communication, and the full suite of functional safety and process safety macro processes for high-risk industries. For SMEs, it provides simplified risk registers and exit/transition support.
e2e.businessValue: Protects the organization from catastrophic failure — whether from safety incidents, cyber attacks, supply chain disruption, or regulatory action.

e2e.name: Compliance To Achievement
e2e.goals: Deploy, audit, certify, maintain the management system
e2e.trigger: Readiness for certification, surveillance audit due, or new compliance obligation
e2e.terminal: Certification achieved or maintained; findings closed; compliance obligations met
e2e.relations: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-10, E2E-12
e2e.modules: Deployment, Audit, Certification, Product Stewardship, EPR, Human Rights, Anti-Bribery, SME Compliance
e2e.mpCodes: UMS033, UMS037, UMS038, DMS035, DMS063–DMS069, DMS090, DMS092, DMS096, DMS099
e2e.narrative: This process manages the certification lifecycle and compliance obligations. It deploys the management system, conducts mock audits and pre-certification gap diagnoses, coordinates certification audits, and manages a portfolio of certifications across multiple standards. It also covers chemical substance compliance, SDS management, extended producer responsibility, human rights due diligence, conflict minerals reporting, modern slavery compliance, and anti-bribery management. For SMEs, it provides quick audit preparation, cost-effective compliance, regulatory alerts, and multi-standard quick certification.
e2e.businessValue: Achieves and maintains certifications that open markets, satisfy customers, and demonstrate regulatory compliance.

e2e.name: People To Capability
e2e.goals: Provide people, competence, documentation, records, measurement, health
e2e.trigger: IMS deployment, new hire, documentation change, or medical surveillance requirement
e2e.terminal: Competent people, controlled documentation, calibrated equipment, health records
e2e.modules: Documentation, Records, Metrology, Medical Surveillance, SME Document
e2e.mpCodes: UMS021, UMS024, UMS001, UMS047, DMS056, DMS084, DMS087
e2e.narrative: This process ensures the organization has the people, documentation, records, measurement resources, and health surveillance in place. It manages the full lifecycle of controlled documents and records, calibrates and controls measurement equipment, conducts medical surveillance and maintains health records, and — for SMEs — provides document templates and multi-role user management.
e2e.businessValue: Provides the operational backbone of the IMS — the documents, records, equipment, and people health that every process depends on.

e2e.name: Infrastructure To Wellbeing
e2e.goals: Provide IT, security, data, technology, environmental infrastructure
e2e.trigger: IT infrastructure change, security threat, data protection requirement, environmental requirement, or facility change
e2e.terminal: Secure compliant IT; data protection; cleanrooms monitored; facilities managed; asset reliability; water efficiency
e2e.modules: Security, Data Protection, Access, Architecture, Asset, Cleanroom, Water, Facility, ITSM, Cloud Security
e2e.mpCodes: UMS045, UMS046, UMS049, UMS051, UMS052, UMS059, UMS056, DMS058, DMS061, DMS071, DMS072, DMS073, DMS074, DMS080
e2e.narrative: This process provides the IT, security, data, technology, and environmental infrastructure required by the IMS. It covers cyber GRC, personal data protection, access and role governance, application and interface repositories, technology lifecycle, tenant sovereignty, configuration governance, asset reliability, cleanroom classification and monitoring, water efficiency, facility management, IT service management, cloud security, and water footprint management.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures the digital and physical infrastructure is secure, compliant, reliable, and environmentally responsible.

e2e.name: Knowledge To Control
e2e.trigger: Data governance requirement, formula change, or knowledge gap
e2e.terminal: Governed data, formulas, calculations, knowledge graph
e2e.narrative: This process governs data, formulas, calculations, and knowledge as organizational assets. It manages master data quality and governance, formula repositories and variable governance, formula execution and traceability, and the knowledge graph that powers AI recommendations.
e2e.businessValue: Turns data and knowledge into reliable, traceable, and reusable organizational intelligence.

e2e.name: Requirements To Delivery

flow.seqTaskIds: DMS008, DMS046, DMS062, DMS075, DMS076, DMS078, DMS079

e2e.trigger: Customer order, production plan, supplier onboarding, welding requirement, laboratory test, or eco-design
e2e.terminal: Products/services delivered; suppliers controlled; traceability ensured; quality validated; LCA completed
e2e.modules: Operations, Supplier, Traceability, Mobile, Welding, Laboratory, Eco-design, LCA, SME Process
e2e.mpCodes: UMS025, UMS026, UMS007, DMS008, DMS009, DMS029, DMS041, DMS046, DMS062, DMS075, DMS076, DMS078, DMS079, DMS094
e2e.narrative: This process transforms requirements into delivered products and services. It manages operational planning and control, product/service requirements, external provider control, production and service provision, release of products/services, nonconforming outputs control, emergency preparedness, supplier quality performance, supply chain resilience and traceability, supplier ecosystem intelligence, mobile-first field operations, supplier collaboration, product traceability and recall, welding quality, testing and calibration labs, medical labs, eco-design, life cycle assessment, and — for SMEs — informal process digitization.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures that what the customer receives is what the customer was promised — conforming, traceable, safe, and sustainable.

e2e.name: Verification To Preparedness
e2e.goals: Detect, contain, resolve, capitalize nonconformities and problems
e2e.trigger: Nonconformity detected, incident reported, or problem identified
e2e.terminal: Problem resolved; REX capitalized; KB updated
e2e.modules: NCP, AI Agent, Knowledge Base, Alert, SME NCP
e2e.mpCodes: UMS011–UMS015, DMS021, DMS022, DMS023, DMS026, DMS015, DMS020, DMS030, DMS097
e2e.narrative: This process detects, contains, resolves, and capitalizes nonconformities and problems. It covers problem capture and definition, immediate action, root cause resolution, corrective action execution, nonconformity capitalization and closure, AI knowledge base and RAG, AI agent orchestration, smart alerting and escalation, REX capitalization, automated root cause intelligence, automated CAPA recommendation, voice-to-text reporting, and — for SMEs — simplified nonconformity management.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures that every problem is not just fixed but converted into reusable organizational knowledge.

e2e.name: Monitoring To Evaluation
e2e.goals: Monitor performance, evaluate results, steer the organization
e2e.trigger: Monitoring periodicity, performance deviation, or governance review
e2e.terminal: Performance evaluated; governance decisions made; improvements identified
e2e.modules: KPI, Dashboard, Governance, Customer, Audit, Benchmarking, AR, Remote Audit, SME KPI
e2e.mpCodes: UMS027, UMS028, UMS029, UMS010, UMS034, UMS036, UMS039, UMS040, GRC008, GRC010, UMS005, DMS010, DMS011, DMS016, DMS032, DMS036, DMS042, DMS086, DMS089, DMS095
e2e.narrative: This process monitors performance, evaluates results, and steers the organization. It manages KPIs, alerts and escalation, real-time dashboards, performance indicator consolidation, system performance monitoring, operational process performance reviews, governance bodies and reviews, customer satisfaction barometers, internal audit cycles, executive GRC reporting, continual improvement pipeline, customer experience intelligence, voice-of-customer analytics, cross-site benchmarking, AR-guided audits, remote audits, customer complaint portals, and — for SMEs — peer benchmarking, essential KPI dashboards, and owner dashboards.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures the organization knows how it is performing and makes decisions based on real data.

e2e.name: Audit To Assurance
e2e.goals: Provide assurance through AI, foresight, IoT, ESG, analytics
e2e.trigger: Predictive analytics alert, regulatory change, or assurance requirement
e2e.terminal: Risks predicted; compliance assured; ESG and carbon reported
e2e.modules: AI, Regulatory, Standards, Document, Simulation, ESG, Mining, IoT
e2e.mpCodes: DMS001, DMS002, DMS003, DMS004, DMS005, DMS006, DMS007, DMS014, DMS017, DMS019, DMS027, DMS031, DMS038, DMS045
e2e.narrative: This process provides assurance through AI, foresight, IoT, ESG, and advanced analytics. It covers AI predictive risk intelligence, automated regulatory horizon scanning, multi-standard cross-mapping, intelligent document generation, digital twin simulation, ESG and sustainability performance, carbon footprint, natural language process mining, predictive compliance, real-time regulatory change impact, AI explainability, IoT integration, task mining, and Scope 3 emissions.
e2e.businessValue: Moves the organization from reactive compliance to predictive assurance — seeing risks and opportunities before they materialize.

e2e.name: Correction To Innovation
e2e.goals: Drive continual improvement, innovation, automation, ecosystem
e2e.trigger: Improvement opportunity, innovation idea, or automation candidate
e2e.terminal: Improvements implemented; innovations deployed; ecosystem expanded
e2e.ufTasks: UF-51 to UF-61, UF-SME-11, UF-SME-13, UF-SME-14
e2e.modules: Improvement, AI, Simulation, ROI, Innovation, Blockchain, Composable, Collaboration, Signature, Low-Code, Marketplace, SME Growth, SME Improvement, SME Community
e2e.mpCodes: UMS017, UMS041, UMS042, UMS057, UMS062, UMS063, UMS064, DMS012, DMS018, DMS024, DMS025, DMS028, DMS033, DMS039, DMS040, DMS093, DMS098, DMS100
e2e.narrative: This process drives continual improvement, innovation, automation, and ecosystem growth. It covers AI management system supervision, optimization and automation project management, macro process discovery, enterprise simulation, automation scoring, ROI and VOI lifecycle, innovation pipeline, blockchain audit trail, composable module governance, multi-tenant isolation, real-time collaboration, digital signatures, low-code workflow builder, marketplace for templates, and — for SMEs — growth readiness, budget-conscious improvement, and collaborative community.
e2e.businessValue: Ensures that the organization does not just maintain compliance but continuously improves, innovates, and grows.

e2eWorkbook.Name: Context To Strategy
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Define context, policy, strategy, objectives, compliance, governance
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Strategic planning cycle, management review output, or significant context change
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Approved policy, strategy, objectives, risk register, compliance framework in place
e2eWorkbook.Relationship_To_Other_Chains: Feeds E2E-02, E2E-03, E2E-04; Informs E2E-08, E2E-10, E2E-12

e2eWorkbook.Name: Leadership To Commitment
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Establish leadership, competence, communication, audit capability
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Competent personnel, communication plan, qualified auditors in place
e2eWorkbook.Relationship_To_Other_Chains: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-05, E2E-08

e2eWorkbook.Name: Risk To Resilience
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Manage controls, third-party risk, continuity, functional safety, process safety, crisis
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Risk assessment cycle, incident, regulatory change, or functional safety requirement
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Controls, third-party risk managed, continuity tested, functional/process safety assured, crisis ready
e2eWorkbook.Relationship_To_Other_Chains: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-11, E2E-12

e2eWorkbook.Name: Compliance To Achievement
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Deploy, audit, certify, maintain the management system
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Readiness for certification, surveillance audit due, or new compliance obligation
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Certification achieved or maintained; findings closed; compliance obligations met
e2eWorkbook.Relationship_To_Other_Chains: Partition of E2E-01; Feeds E2E-10, E2E-12

e2eWorkbook.Name: People To Capability
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Provide people, competence, documentation, records, measurement, health
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: IMS deployment, new hire, documentation change, or medical surveillance requirement
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Competent people, controlled documentation, calibrated equipment, health records

e2eWorkbook.Name: Infrastructure To Wellbeing
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Provide IT, security, data, technology, environmental infrastructure
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: IT infrastructure change, security threat, data protection requirement, environmental requirement, or facility change
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Secure compliant IT; data protection; cleanrooms monitored; facilities managed; asset reliability; water efficiency

e2eWorkbook.Name: Knowledge To Control
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Data governance requirement, formula change, or knowledge gap
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Governed data, formulas, calculations, knowledge graph

e2eWorkbook.Name: Requirements To Delivery
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Customer order, production plan, supplier onboarding, welding requirement, laboratory test, or eco-design
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Products/services delivered; suppliers controlled; traceability ensured; quality validated; LCA completed

e2eWorkbook.Name: Verification To Preparedness
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Detect, contain, resolve, capitalize nonconformities and problems
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Nonconformity detected, incident reported, or problem identified
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Problem resolved; REX capitalized; KB updated

e2eWorkbook.Name: Monitoring To Evaluation
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Monitor performance, evaluate results, steer the organization
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Monitoring periodicity, performance deviation, or governance review
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Performance evaluated; governance decisions made; improvements identified

e2eWorkbook.Name: Audit To Assurance
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Provide assurance through AI, foresight, IoT, ESG, analytics
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Predictive analytics alert, regulatory change, or assurance requirement
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Risks predicted; compliance assured; ESG and carbon reported

e2eWorkbook.Name: Correction To Innovation
e2eWorkbook.Goals: Drive continual improvement, innovation, automation, ecosystem
e2eWorkbook.Trigger: Improvement opportunity, innovation idea, or automation candidate
e2eWorkbook.Terminal_State: Improvements implemented; innovations deployed; ecosystem expanded

functions.Description: Context, policy, objectives, communication, governance bodies and executive reporting.
Problem solving, corrective action, continual improvement, metrology, laboratories and welding quality.
Occupational health and safety, functional and process safety, maritime safety and environmental protection.

Compliance obligations, regulatory watch, standards harmonization, deployment and certification.
Internal audit, auditor qualification, investigations and audit-trail assurance.
Document and record lifecycle, document generation, co-authoring, signatures and knowledge graph.
Cyber security, data protection, access, architecture, configuration, formulas, tenancy and IT services.
Operational control, suppliers, traceability, field operations, assets, facilities and cleanrooms.
KPIs, alerts, dashboards, performance reviews, benchmarking and customer feedback.
ESG performance, carbon, water, eco-design and life cycle assessment.
AI management, automation, simulation, ROI/VOI, innovation, IoT, low-code and ecosystem.
Process architecture, SIPOC, procedures, control plans, business rules and process discovery.

sampleElements.Element_Name: Respond to customer and close complaint

mpSheets.Name: Customer Order Management
mpSheets.Inputs: Customer purchase orders and requests for quotation; price list; production capacity; customer credit status
mpSheets.Outputs: Order confirmation; registered sales order in ERP; order rejection notice
mpSheets.Goals: Confirm 100% of feasible orders within 48 h; zero orders accepted beyond capacity; zero pricing errors
mpSheets.Distribution_List: Sales team; Production Manager; Finance Manager; QHSE Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: 1 Sales Manager, 2 Sales Administrators (order entry, customer contact); competence in product range and ERP
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: ERP order module; CRM; e-mail; order review checklist in DynamicMS

mpSheets.Name: Customer Complaint Handling
mpSheets.Inputs: Customer complaints (portal, e-mail, phone); delivery and batch records
mpSheets.Outputs: Registered complaint; investigation report; customer response; corrective action request
mpSheets.Goals: Acknowledge complaints within 24 h; close 90% within 15 working days; reduce repeat complaints
mpSheets.Distribution_List: Sales team; QHSE Manager; Production Manager; General Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: Sales Administrator (registration), QHSE Manager (investigation); competence in root cause analysis
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: CRM ticketing; DynamicMS NC module; laboratory for sample analysis

mpSheets.Name: Recruitment & Onboarding
mpSheets.Inputs: Approved headcount; job descriptions; candidate applications
mpSheets.Outputs: Signed employment contract; completed onboarding checklist; employee record in HRIS
mpSheets.Goals: Fill approved positions within 45 days; complete onboarding including OH&S induction before first shift
mpSheets.Distribution_List: HR team; Line Managers; QHSE Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: HR Manager, HR Assistant; interview panel of line managers

mpSheets.Name: Competence & Training
mpSheets.Inputs: Competence requirements per role; competence gap assessments; training requests
mpSheets.Outputs: Annual training plan; training records; effectiveness evaluations
mpSheets.Goals: Close 80% of competence gaps within the year; 100% mandatory safety training on time
mpSheets.Distribution_List: HR team; Line Managers; QHSE Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: HR Manager, internal trainers, external training providers
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: HRIS; e-learning platform; DynamicMS competence matrix

mpSheets.Name: Production Planning & Control
mpSheets.Inputs: Confirmed sales orders; stock levels; capacity calendar; maintenance plan
mpSheets.Outputs: Production plan; released production orders; batch records; production reports
mpSheets.Goals: On-time production start above 95%; scrap rate below 2%; zero environmental incidents
mpSheets.Distribution_List: Production team; Sales Manager; Maintenance Manager; QHSE Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: Production Manager, Production Planner, 3 Shift Supervisors, operators
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: ERP planning module; production lines; spill kits and retention tanks

mpSheets.Name: Equipment Maintenance
mpSheets.Inputs: Equipment register; preventive maintenance plan; breakdown requests
mpSheets.Outputs: Completed interventions; maintenance reports; updated equipment history
mpSheets.Goals: Planned maintenance compliance above 95%; zero lost-time injuries during interventions
mpSheets.Distribution_List: Maintenance team; Production Manager; QHSE Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: Maintenance Manager, 4 technicians with electrical and mechanical authorizations
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: CMMS; tooling; lock-out/tag-out kits; spare-parts store

mpSheets.Name: Supplier Selection & Evaluation
mpSheets.Inputs: Purchasing needs; supplier questionnaires; delivery and quality performance data
mpSheets.Outputs: Approved supplier list; supplier evaluation reports; development plans
mpSheets.Goals: 100% of critical suppliers evaluated annually; supplier on-time delivery above 95%
mpSheets.Distribution_List: Purchasing team; QHSE Manager; Production Manager
mpSheets.Human_Resources: Purchasing Manager, Buyers; QHSE Engineer for supplier audits

mpSheets.Name: Purchase Order Management
mpSheets.Inputs: Purchase requisitions; approved supplier list; budgets
mpSheets.Outputs: Issued purchase orders; goods receipts; receiving inspection records
mpSheets.Goals: Issue purchase orders within 2 days of approved requisition; zero orders to non-approved suppliers
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: ERP purchasing module; receiving area and inspection tools

mpSheets.Name: Document & Record Control
mpSheets.Inputs: New or changed documents; change requests; retention rules
mpSheets.Outputs: Approved and published document versions; distribution acknowledgements; archived versions
mpSheets.Goals: Approval cycle within 5 working days; zero use of obsolete documents found in audits
mpSheets.Human_Resources: Document Controller; process owners as authors

mpSheets.Name: Internal Audit
mpSheets.Inputs: Audit programme; process risks; previous audit results; SIPOC and procedures as audit criteria
mpSheets.Outputs: Audit plans; audit reports; findings; follow-up records
mpSheets.Goals: Complete 100% of the audit programme; close findings within agreed dates
mpSheets.Distribution_List: QHSE Manager; General Manager; audited process owners
mpSheets.Technical_IT_Infrastructure_Resources: DynamicMS audit module; tablets for on-site audits

sheetInteractions.Exchanged_Information: Confirmed sales orders and delivery dates
Current document versions used as audit criteria
Complaint data used in audit planning

sheetTasks.Brief_Description: Order captured in ERP and CRM
sheetTasks.Detailed_Description: Sales Administrator checks order completeness (items, quantities, delivery address, requested date), creates the sales order in ERP and links the CRM opportunity.

sheetTasks.Goals: Accept only orders that can be fulfilled
sheetTasks.Brief_Description: Feasibility, capacity, credit and price checks
sheetTasks.Detailed_Description: Review decomposed into three activities (technical feasibility, capacity and delivery date, credit and pricing); any failed check leads to a negotiation or rejection.
Order confirmation generated from ERP with confirmed delivery date and sent to the customer; signed confirmation filed as record.
Complaint recorded with evidence, product and batch references, severity assessed and acknowledgement sent to the customer.
QHSE Manager analyses samples and records, performs root cause analysis and decides whether a corrective action is required.

sheetTasks.Task_Name: Respond to customer and close complaint
sheetTasks.Detailed_Description: Sales Manager sends the response with actions taken; the complaint is closed once the customer accepts or after 10 working days without reply.
Line Manager raises a request against approved headcount with job description reference.
HR screens applications, organizes panel interviews and issues the offer after reference checks.

sheetTasks.Goals: Operational and safe from day one
sheetTasks.Detailed_Description: HR runs the onboarding checklist including OH&S induction, IT access and job-specific training assignment.
Line Managers assess competence against requirements and record gaps.
Trainers deliver sessions; attendance and assessments are recorded.
Line Managers evaluate effectiveness 30 to 90 days after training and update the competence matrix.
Planner builds the plan from confirmed orders, stock, capacity and maintenance windows.

sheetTasks.Goals: Release only when materials and equipment are ready
sheetTasks.Detailed_Description: Production Manager releases orders after material availability and equipment status checks.
Shift Supervisors monitor output, scrap and environmental controls and record deviations.
Maintenance Manager plans interventions from CMMS schedules aligned with production windows.
Decomposed into lock-out/tag-out, intervention execution and restart verification activities.
Questionnaire, certificates review and, for critical suppliers, an on-site audit.
Quarterly scorecard on delivery, quality and responsiveness; development plan below threshold.
Requester creates a requisition in ERP within budget.
Buyer selects an approved supplier, negotiates and issues the order.
Warehouse Keeper checks quantities and documents; samples are inspected per plan.
Author drafts or revises the document in DynamicMS with change summary.
Reviewers comment, approver signs, the system publishes and distributes the version.
Superseded versions are archived and removed from points of use.
Lead Auditor prepares the plan, scope, criteria and team.
Opening meeting, interviews, evidence sampling against SIPOC and procedures, closing meeting.
Report issued, corrective actions tracked to closure and effectiveness verified.

sheetKpis.Formula: Average hours from order receipt to confirmation
Number of confirmed orders later rescheduled for capacity
Complaints closed within 15 working days / complaints closed x 100
Complaints with same root cause in 12 months / total complaints x 100
Average days from approved request to signed contract
Employees with valid mandatory safety training / employees requiring it x 100
Scrap quantity / total produced quantity x 100
Orders started on planned date / orders released x 100
Preventive interventions done on time / planned x 100
Number of lost-time injuries during interventions
Purchase orders issued to non-approved suppliers
Average working days from submission to publication
Findings closed by due date / findings due x 100

sheetSections.Content: Automotive customers require PPAP level 3 for new parts; food-contact customers require declaration of compliance.
Acknowledgement and closure letter templates in English, French and Arabic.
Solvent emissions (significant), wastewater (significant), packaging waste (not significant) with operational controls.
Electrical isolation verified; mechanical energy released; permit to work signed; PPE checked.
Used oil (hazardous waste) collected in labelled containers; refrigerant handling by certified technician.
Each auditor mapped to processes they must not audit.

compositeSheets.Aggregation_Rule: Order by sheet; merge RACSI by role; union of risks, documents and applications; KPIs listed per member
Order by value chain; interactions between members shown as a flow; shared resources de-duplicated
Order by ISO 9001 clause; members' KPIs consolidated in one table

sipocRegister.Trigger: Order received by e-mail or phone
sipocRegister.Inputs: Customer order (unstructured e-mail); verbal price information
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Orders re-keyed manually into ERP; feasibility checked informally by phone with production; no credit check before confirmation; confirmations sent from personal mailboxes.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: None formalized

sipocRegister.Trigger: Order received through CRM, customer portal or e-mail
sipocRegister.Inputs: Structured customer order; price list; capacity calendar; credit status
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Orders captured once in CRM and synchronized to ERP; review performed through three activities (feasibility, capacity, credit and pricing) with evidence; confirmation generated from ERP with confirmed date.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Order confirmation with confirmed delivery date; sales order in ERP
sipocRegister.End_Events: Order confirmed; order rejected with reason
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go if feasible, capacity available by requested date, credit within limit and price validated; otherwise No-Go and negotiation

sipocRegister.Trigger: Complaint received by phone or e-mail
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Complaints logged in a spreadsheet; investigation assigned informally; no response deadline.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: None formalized

sipocRegister.Trigger: Complaint received via customer portal, CRM ticket, e-mail or phone
sipocRegister.Inputs: Complaint with evidence; product and batch references
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Registration within 24 h; severity classification; investigation with root cause analysis; corrective action for major complaints; response and closure with customer acceptance.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Investigation report; customer response; corrective action request
sipocRegister.End_Events: Complaint closed accepted; complaint closed without reply after 10 days
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to corrective action if severity Major or repeat root cause; Go to closure if customer accepts response

sipocRegister.Trigger: Approved recruitment request
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Sourcing, screening, interviews, offer, onboarding with OH&S induction before first shift.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to offer if panel score >= 70% and references positive

sipocRegister.Trigger: Annual planning cycle or new competence gap
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Needs consolidated into annual plan; sessions delivered; effectiveness evaluated 30-90 days later.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Training plan; training records; effectiveness evaluations
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to competence confirmation if evaluation >= required level

sipocRegister.Trigger: Weekly planning cycle
sipocRegister.Inputs: Confirmed orders; stock; capacity; maintenance windows
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Weekly plan built in ERP; orders released after material and equipment checks; line monitoring with scrap and environmental controls.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Production plan; released orders; batch records
sipocRegister.End_Events: Order completed; order put on hold
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to release if materials available and equipment status Available

sipocRegister.Trigger: Breakdown reported by operator
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Mostly corrective maintenance; paper work orders; lock-out practiced inconsistently.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: None formalized

sipocRegister.Trigger: CMMS preventive schedule due or breakdown request
sipocRegister.Inputs: Maintenance plan; work order; equipment history
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Preventive plan aligned with production windows; interventions under lock-out/tag-out with permit; restart verified by supervisor; history updated in CMMS.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Completed intervention; maintenance report; updated history
sipocRegister.End_Events: Equipment released to production; equipment quarantined
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to restart only if lock-out removed by the person who applied it and functional test passed

sipocRegister.Trigger: New supplier needed or evaluation period ends
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Pre-qualification with questionnaire and certificates; audit for critical suppliers; quarterly scorecards; development plan below threshold.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to approval if qualification score >= 70 and no critical finding

sipocRegister.Trigger: Approved purchase requisition
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Supplier selected from approved list; order issued in ERP; goods received and inspected per sampling plan.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Purchase order; goods receipt; inspection record
sipocRegister.End_Events: Goods accepted; goods rejected and returned
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to acceptance if quantity and inspection results conform

sipocRegister.Trigger: Document change requested by e-mail
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Documents edited on shared drive; approvals by e-mail; old copies remain in folders.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: None formalized

sipocRegister.Trigger: Change request or scheduled review in DynamicMS
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Drafting in DynamicMS; review and approval workflow; automatic versioning; publication with distribution and acknowledgement; superseded versions archived.
sipocRegister.Outputs: Published version; generated files (Word, PDF); acknowledgements
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to publication only after approval by the Accountable role different from the author

sipocRegister.Trigger: Audit programme period starts
sipocRegister.Inputs: Audit programme; process risks; SIPOC and procedures
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Risk-based planning; audit against To-Be SIPOC and procedures; report within 5 days; follow-up of findings.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to closure when all findings have accepted action plans

sipocRegister.Trigger: Order line prices to validate
sipocRegister.Inputs: Order lines; current price list; discount rules
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Each line price compared with the price list; discounts above 10% routed to Sales Manager.
sipocRegister.End_Events: Prices validated; prices sent back for negotiation
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go if all lines match the price list or approved discount

sipocRegister.Trigger: Complaint received on any channel
sipocRegister.Inputs: Complaint description; evidence; product and batch references
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Record complaint, check duplicates, classify severity, send acknowledgement within 24 h.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go to investigation if complaint is valid and not a duplicate

sipocRegister.Trigger: Work order assigned
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Technician executes repair; parts taken from store without record.
sipocRegister.Go_No_Go_Criteria: None formalized

sipocRegister.Trigger: Equipment locked out and permit signed
sipocRegister.Inputs: Work order; spare parts; permit to work
sipocRegister.Fine_Grained_Details: Execute intervention per work instruction; record parts used in CMMS; record findings and time spent.

procedures.Title: Register customer complaint
procedures.Goals: Capture every complaint within 24 h with complete information and acknowledge it.
procedures.Scope_of_Work: Applies to all complaints from customers on any channel, for all products; excludes warranty claims handled by distributors.
procedures.Definitions: Complaint: expression of dissatisfaction about a product or service. Duplicate: complaint on the same batch and defect already registered.
procedures.Main_Documents_and_Information: Complaint form; product and batch references; photos or samples; CRM ticket
procedures.End_Events: Complaint registered; duplicate merged; complaint rejected as out of scope
procedures.Reporting: Weekly complaint register report to Sales Manager; monthly trend report to management
procedures.Alerts: Alert if not acknowledged within 24 h; alert to QHSE Manager when severity Major

procedures.Title: Issue purchase order
procedures.Goals: Issue purchase orders to approved suppliers within 2 days of requisition approval.
procedures.Scope_of_Work: All purchases of materials, spare parts and services above the petty-cash threshold.
procedures.Definitions: Approved supplier: supplier listed as Approved in the approved supplier list. Quotation threshold: purchases above the tenant-defined amount.
procedures.Main_Documents_and_Information: Purchase requisition; approved supplier list; quotations; purchase order
procedures.End_Events: Purchase order issued; requisition returned to requester
procedures.Go_No_Go_Decisions: Supplier approved? Quotation required? Budget available?
procedures.Reporting: Monthly purchase order report; supplier spend report
procedures.Alerts: Alert if requisition pending more than 2 days; block if supplier not approved

procedures.Title: Execute maintenance intervention
procedures.Goals: Perform maintenance safely and restore equipment function.
procedures.Scope_of_Work: Preventive and corrective interventions on production equipment after lock-out/tag-out.
procedures.Definitions: Permit to work: authorization to intervene on isolated equipment. LOTO: lock-out/tag-out.
procedures.Main_External_Interactions: CMMS (ManWinWin); spare-parts supplier for urgent parts
procedures.Main_Documents_and_Information: Work order; permit to work; work instruction; spare parts; intervention report
procedures.End_Events: Intervention completed; intervention escalated to external contractor
procedures.Go_No_Go_Decisions: Isolation verified? Parts available? Repair successful?
procedures.Reporting: Intervention report per work order; monthly maintenance KPI report
procedures.Alerts: Alert to QHSE Manager on any unsafe condition; alert if intervention exceeds planned duration by 50%

procedures.Title: Approve and publish document
procedures.Goals: Publish only reviewed and approved document versions and inform users.
procedures.Scope_of_Work: All controlled internal documents, sheets, SIPOC and procedures.
procedures.Definitions: Accountable approver: role holding A in the document RACSI. Major change: change of content or requirements; minor: editorial.
procedures.Main_Documents_and_Information: Draft version; review comments; change summary; generated files
procedures.Go_No_Go_Decisions: All comments resolved? Approver different from author? Major or minor change?
procedures.Reporting: Document version history report; weekly pending approvals report
procedures.Alerts: Alert if approval pending more than 5 working days; alert on overdue acknowledgements

procedureSteps.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go if in scope and no open complaint on same batch and defect
Major if safety, regulatory or repeat defect

procedureSteps.Step_Name: Inform customer complaint is out of scope
Notify QHSE Manager of Major complaint

procedureSteps.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go only if supplier status Approved
Go to order when best offer meets technical requirements
Go if remaining budget covers order amount

procedureSteps.Step_Name: Equipment locked out and permit signed

procedureSteps.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go only if all energy sources isolated and verified

procedureSteps.Step_Name: Record intervention and parts in CMMS
Stop work and report unsafe condition
Order urgent parts or escalate to contractor

procedureSteps.Go_No_Go_Criteria: Go if approver differs from author; classify change Major or Minor

procedureSteps.Outputs: Published version; Word and PDF files; notifications

controls.Description: Author cannot approve their own version; approval requires a different user holding the Accountable role.
Approved, Published and Superseded versions are read-only; changes require a new version.
Files from non-published versions carry a DRAFT watermark; superseded versions carry SUPERSEDED.
Every download and share is logged with user, format, version and timestamp.
Sheets and procedures cannot be published without a complete, approved To-Be SIPOC.
Enforces parent-child level consistency and named levels.
RACSI must hold exactly one Accountable role for sheets, SIPOC, procedures and KPIs.
Tracks read acknowledgements and escalates overdue ones.
Checks end events, gateways and exception paths before BPMN generation.
Template changes affecting mandatory sections require Document Controller approval.
Custom values are unique, attributed to a creator and retired rather than deleted when in use.
Review due date computed from the policy review frequency; overdue reviews reported.
Analysis frequency cannot be more frequent than measurement frequency.
Reports monitoring occurrences not executed by their due date.
AI-generated content is held as a suggestion until a named user accepts it.
Access limited by role and data scope.
Quarterly recertification of privileged roles.
Personal data fields are masked in generated files unless the template explicitly includes them and the user holds the permission.
Formula must pass test execution before KPI activation.
Records cannot be disposed before retention end or without approval.
Purchase orders blocked for non-approved suppliers.
Actions closed only after effectiveness evidence is recorded.
Auditor cannot audit a process element they own.
Annual test with documented results.
All configuration changes are logged with before/after values.
Custom AI use cases stay inactive until approved by the AI Governance Officer.
SSO, MFA and session rules enforced for all users.
Requests tracked against the legal response deadline.

policies.Title: Quality Policy
policies.Policy_Scope: All sites; design, manufacture and delivery of products
policies.Commitments: Satisfy customer and applicable requirements; continually improve the QMS; set and review quality objectives; ensure competent personnel.

policies.Title: QHSE Integrated Policy
policies.Policy_Scope: All sites and activities, including contractors on site
policies.Commitments: Quality: customer satisfaction and compliance. Environment: protection of the environment including pollution prevention; fulfilment of compliance obligations. OH&S: safe and healthy working conditions; eliminate hazards and reduce risks; consultation and participation of workers. Common: continual improvement and objectives framework.
policies.Communication_Channels: Intranet; notice boards; onboarding; supplier portal

policies.Title: Information Security Policy
policies.Policy_Scope: IT systems and information assets of all sites
policies.Commitments: Protect confidentiality, integrity and availability of information; comply with legal and contractual requirements; continually improve the ISMS.
